thesis: 가장 강한 공매도 논리는 'AI 수요가 사라진다'가 아니라 NVIDIA가 수요를 공급약정·연장결제·보증으로 더 많이 떠받치면서 과거의 fabless 초고 ROIC가 자본집약적으로 변한다는 것이다. Q2 DSO는 60일, 미래약정은 $366B, 최대 총보증노출은 $108.5B다. 여기에 Data Center 매출 집중·고객 집중·custom ASIC을 결합하면 성장 정상화 시 -50%대 하방은 현실적이다. 다만 현재 현금창출·75% gross margin·광범위한 Rubin 주문 때문에 Hard Veto는 아직 확정되지 않는다.

evidence.claim: Q2 FY27 DSO rose to 60 days from 45 because of extended payment terms on large multi-quarter agreements, and the 10-Q states some investment-grade customers may receive payment terms from 90 days up to one year.
evidence.value: DSO 60 vs 45; some terms 90 days to 1 year

evidence.claim: Future commitments totaled $366B, including $279B of supply/capacity commitments, up from $119B in the prior quarter.
CFO commentary disclosed maximum gross guarantee exposure of $108.5B, including $105.0B related to SB Energy and $3.5B of land/power/shell guarantees for AI clouds.
Five direct customers accounted for 22%, 14%, 13%, 11%, and 10% of accounts receivable; one direct customer was 16% of Q2 FY27 revenue.
evidence.value: AR 22/14/13/11/10%; one direct customer 16% of revenue

evidence.claim: The counterweight is exceptional current economics: Q2 gross margin was 75.0%, H1 operating cash flow was $74.421B, and Data Center revenue was $89.0B.
NVIDIA's 2026 10-K explicitly identifies large cloud companies with internal accelerator teams as competitors and notes some customers can develop their own solutions to replace NVIDIA offerings.
evidence.value: Hyperscaler internal silicon is an explicit competitive risk

counterevidence: Q2 revenue and operating income more than doubled year over year while gross margin held at 75%, so there is no current evidence of demand or ROIC collapse.
Rubin production shipments and purchase orders from every major hyperscaler, AI cloud and system OEM argue against an immediate product-demand break.
H1 operating cash flow of $74.4B and substantial liquidity make forced external financing unlikely under current conditions.
NVIDIA's CUDA/install-base ecosystem plus networking and CPU expansion gives it defenses that a single custom accelerator cannot fully replace.
unknowns: Probability-weighted loss and recourse terms for the $108.5B gross guarantees
Cancelable/reschedulable portion of the $279B supply/capacity commitments in a severe demand downturn
Share of future hyperscaler workloads that migrate to internal/custom accelerators
falsifiers: Short thesis weakens materially if DSO normalizes, guarantee/commitment exposure stabilizes relative to FCF, and Rubin repeat orders remain broad through FY28.
Short thesis is largely falsified if independent customer data confirms durable TCO superiority while custom ASIC share stays limited and gross margin remains near current levels.
Short thesis strengthens sharply if FCF conversion falls for several quarters while AR, guarantees and commitments continue rising.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Q2 10-Q states disclosure controls were effective and no material ICFR change occurred; no restatement or decisive accounting-integrity evidence was identified.
Despite large commitments and guarantees, H1 OCF was $74.4B and current liquidity is substantial; survival does not presently depend on repeated external capital raising.

Financing/support is material and must be monitored, but $89B Data Center revenue, 75% gross margin and broad platform orders show substantial underlying customer value rather than subsidy-only demand.
Commitments/guarantees reduce forward ROIC visibility, but current operating income and OCF growth do not show structural incremental-return collapse.
Custom silicon is a credible threat, but current evidence still shows expanding CUDA/platform adoption, Rubin demand and networking/CPU attachment rather than persistent moat shrinkage.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Data Center and large customers are concentrated, but no single customer is fatal; demand spans multiple hyperscalers/AI clouds/OEMs, and the platform extends across GPU, CPU, networking and software.

key_kpis.name: DSO + guarantees + commitments
key_kpis.threshold: Do not rise persistently faster than revenue and FCF

key_kpis.name: Data Center gross margin/FCF conversion
key_kpis.threshold: No multi-quarter deterioration consistent with subsidized or overbuilt demand

key_kpis.name: Custom-silicon displacement
key_kpis.threshold: Top customers do not shift a structurally rising share of incremental AI spend away from NVIDIA

next_checks: Q3 FY27 financing/guarantee disclosure and DSO
Rubin repeat orders and independent customer ROI
